title: Install OLake UI
text:
Install OLake UI | olake > Quick start
Run OLake UI with Docker Compose:
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datazip-inc/olake-ui/master/docker-compose-v1.yml | docker compose -f - up -d
```
Open http://localhost:8000 and log in with the default credentials admin / password. Change them for production.

title: Install OLake UI
text:
Install OLake UI | olake > Disable telemetry
To opt out of anonymous telemetry, set TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true in the environment of the olake-ui service in docker-compose-v1.yml, then restart the stack with docker compose up -d.

title: Postgres
text:
Postgres | olake > Prerequisites
Postgres CDC needs wal_level = logical and the pgoutput logical decoding plugin. OLake supports Postgres 10 and later.

title: Postgres

| Postgres type | Iceberg type |
|---|---|
| jsonb | string |
| numeric | decimal |
| bigint | long |

title: Postgres
text:
Postgres | olake > Configuration
Postgres source.json fields: host, port, database, username, password, update_method (Standalone or CDC with replication_slot and publication) and max_threads for parallel chunking.

title: Postgres
text:
Postgres | olake > Troubleshooting
Error `LSN not updated after 5 minutes`: the replication slot did not advance. Check that the publication covers the synced tables and that WAL is being generated for the Postgres database.

title: Postgres on Amazon RDS
text:
Postgres on Amazon RDS | olake > Enable logical replication
On Amazon RDS, the default parameter group cannot be edited. Create a custom parameter group, set rds.logical_replication = 1, attach it to the Postgres instance and reboot.

title: MySQL
text:
MySQL | olake > Prerequisites
MySQL CDC needs binlog_format = ROW, binlog_row_image = FULL and binlog_row_metadata = FULL. The MySQL connector also covers MariaDB.

title: Oracle
text:
Oracle | olake > Sync modes
The Oracle connector supports Full Refresh and Incremental sync. CDC is not supported for Oracle.

title: known issue #867
text:
known issue #867 (closed; fixed in v0.3.0)
DB2 driver fails on arm64 Linux; use an amd64 host.

title: Iceberg table maintenance
text:
Iceberg table maintenance | outside OLake docs
Expire snapshots and remove orphan files regularly. Compaction rewrites small data files into larger files. Iceberg maintenance: expire snapshots, orphan files, compaction.

title: Types of compaction
text:
Types of compaction | fusion > Compaction types
Fusion runs Lite, Medium and Full compaction. Full compaction rewrites data files and removes deleted rows; snapshots and orphan files are not expired by Fusion.
